comparison.objective: Seat a graphics card squarely so its connector, bracket gap, and far guide engage together; candidate breaks and recovers insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: GPU task tests multi-feature alignment and square connector insertion; candidate tests coaxial mandrel placement, bimanual hammering, lateral-load control, and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Only the task title and folder reference are available, so numeric seating and damage criteria are missing; candidate explicitly requires four fractures, intact inserts and shell, and four contained fragments.
comparison.reason: Constrained multi-feature insertion is a different tested ability from impact fracture and debris recovery; absent rubric thresholds do not suggest duplication.
